description: Completeness at the noise cap (pq-zether.md 4.3, 14; P6e D9): K_MAX - 1 = 1,023 proven-norm credits to a known receiver key, aligned to maximise the decryption noise in coefficient 0, plus the plain unit, summed into T; the receiver's debit R_TX over T proves and verifies in both systems. Stored as seeds, per-credit ctHash and the aggregate (not 1,023 ciphertexts). The noise stays under the proven range 2^24 and the K_MAX * B_FRESH bound.
alignment: Noise of a credit in coefficient 0 = <rot(e), r> - <rot(s), e1> + e2[0] for the receiver key (s, e), rot(x) per poly = (x_0, -x_63, ..., -x_1). r: the same for every credit, greedy max of <rot(e), r> with ||r||^2 <= 1296 over integer increments (k, a) (gain |w_k|, cost 2a + 1) by gain / cost descending, ties by (k, a). e1 of credit k: every coordinate with rot(s) != 0 at level L (largest with L^2 N <= 26896), X = (26896 - L^2 N) / (2L + 1) of them at L + 1, the X first by (prio, index), prio_i = be32 of SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-WORSTCASE-V1 || generator_seed || be4(k)) bytes 4i..4i+4, sign -sign(rot(s)). e2 = (64, 0, ..., 0). Message digits(credit_value). Credits by pqz_encrypt (C), T = sum of the credits + Trivial(digits(plain_used)) mod q.
